scope:
R8 isolated UI+HTTP audit. Real application HTTP, Git, FFmpeg and audio output.
Synthetic AI/cloud contracts. Vietnamese audio comes from system eSpeak through
an explicitly labelled Piper-compatible TEST adapter, NOT a neural Piper model.
Browser runs shipped HTML/JS in memory because local navigation can be blocked by
platform policy. Production CSP is applied after loading scripts; inline-handler
blocking and delegated clicks are exercised, not network script delivery/WebGL.

checks.name: csp_source_intake
checks.detail: Three delegated source buttons work while an inline onclick control is blocked; actual file attachment is read into reception. No CSP relaxed.

checks.name: radar_csp_fix
checks.detail: Radar button navigates through a delegated handler while inline JS remains blocked by production CSP.

checks.name: idea_media_bridge
checks.detail: Uploaded real PNG through Idea Studio using authenticated HTTP and verified the same source in Media Studio.

checks.name: multi_role_persistence
checks.detail: Two Worker and two Founder members saved through actual UI; opening editor again retains selection and distinct Reviewer.

checks.name: connections_role_groups
checks.detail: Connections tab removes one Worker, appends another without overwriting, and re-saves Council without losing members.

checks.name: voice_preview
checks.detail: Actual WAV from explicitly labelled eSpeak diagnostic adapter passes preview API and audio control. This is not a Piper neural-model acceptance.

checks.name: reception_product_separation
checks.detail: Assignment/events are above results; real images selected and voice explicit before production.

checks.name: project_isolation
checks.detail: Images/voice persist for their own project, not another project. Consent is never carried to the next project.

checks.name: actual_narrated_video
checks.detail: Reception produced an actual H264/AAC MP4 with uploaded illustration and non-silent diagnostic speech; ffprobe/full decode/Range requests pass.

checks.name: video_studio_controls
checks.detail: Same source/voice selection is available in Video Studio; voiced story defaults to cut, not overlapping words.

checks.name: voice_endpoint_access
checks.detail: Preview/setup requires an authenticated local session; locking Vault denies audio access and synthesis.
